breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous shortcut P_max = 2W (the suddenly applied-load result). Instead, it instructs to substitute δ_max into the energy conservation equation to form a quadratic in P_max and solve it properly, which is exactly what the ground truth prompt requires. The nonzero drop height h = 200 mm is fully incorporated into the energy balance, matching the ground truth approach.
